description: Naming, definition and hierarchy checks for an ontology with an explicit class hierarchy, declared in the audit schema sidecar. Multiple inheritance is permitted; declared disjoint classes and inherited relations are checked; a cycle is an error only when the sidecar declares the hierarchy acyclic; roots and naming conventions apply when declared. ART001 checks the ontology file against its contract; the other store artifact, evidence and numeric checks are not part of this profile.
